judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation with almost all of its own facets unchecked and its own acceptance tests in `src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts` guaranteed to fail because `messageHandler.ts`, `createServer.ts`, and `sender.ts` were never updated. Furthermore, the candidate ignored the issue's specifications from the start: it invented `list_sessions` and `session_list` instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list`, allowed `limit: 0` instead of restricting to 1–200, and planned to return an empty list when `listFor` is missing instead of an `UNSUPPORTED` error. It also completely omitted `transport.history` opt-in configuration, `before` cursor validation, `StoreCannotList`, `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`, and all required documentation and changelog updates. Finally, it committed an extraneous `.lore/dod.md` file and modified an existing line in `src/types/messages.ts` despite the acceptance criterion forbidding touching existing lines.
